title: Normalized K-flat monoidal descent for clopen restriction
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a finite set, and $j_i:X_i\hookrightarrow X$ pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes covering $X$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Work on their small pro-etale sites in the fixed universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, $R_i=R|_{X_i}$, and let $r_i$, $G$ and $e_i$ be the restriction, sectionwise product gluing, and zero insertion functors of [lem-pur-clopen-ringed-module-gluing] on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

Use unbounded derived categories and their localizations $Q_R,Q_{R_i}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], flat-term K-flat models [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, def-pc-kflat-complex], and the K-flat derived tensor of [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Write $r_D:D(R)\simeq\prod_iD(R_i)$ for the equivalence with specified degreewise localization comparisons of [lem-pur-clopen-unbounded-derived-localization]. Let $b_{i,P,Q}$ be the pure-tensor normalized total-complex comparison of [lem-pur-clopen-total-tensor-kflat-detection].

There is a unique natural isomorphism of bifunctors on the derived categories
$$c_i:r_{D,i}(K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}L)\xrightarrow{\sim}r_{D,i}K\otimes_{R_i}^{\mathbf L}r_{D,i}L$$
whose restriction to every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes $P,Q$ is $Q_{R_i}(b_{i,P,Q})$, under the canonical localization and K-flat computation comparisons on both sides. The isomorphisms and their inverses are independent of representatives and natural for arbitrary derived morphisms.

Equip each derived category with its prescribed symmetric monoidal structure: the tensor is that K-flat derived tensor, the unit is its ring sheaf in degree zero, and the associator, both unitors and symmetry are induced from total tensors, with symmetry $x_p\otimes y_q\mapsto(-1)^{pq}y_q\otimes x_p$ [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. For these structures, $c_i$ and $r_{D,i}(R[0])\cong R_i[0]$ satisfy the associativity, symmetry, and both unit compatibility diagrams. Consequently $r_D$, with the componentwise tensor on the product, is a symmetric monoidal equivalence. This includes the empty product of zero categories and zero coefficient sheaves.

proof.text: Use the clopen unbounded localization equivalence for Fin(card I). Reindex the component product by Fintype.equivFin; its inverse composite with the tuple of the specified restrictions is the localization equivalence. Cancel the reindexing equivalence to obtain IsEquivalence for the original tuple functor, for every finite I including the empty type.

Apply clopen total tensor detection to obtain the ordinary braided structures, natural total comparisons, pure-tensor equations, summand equations, preservation of K-flat complexes and coproducts. Evaluate the summand equation on a local pure tensor and use its ordinary normalization. By definition the resulting two terms are coefficientTensorGenerator, proving TotalNormalization.

Apply the braided model-normalization lemma to each component with precisely the ordinary structure, total comparison and preservation data just obtained. Its conclusion gives the specified derived braided structure, the model normalization for its inverse tensorator, and the canonical unit equality.

For uniqueness cancel the native K-flat computation isomorphism and the tensor of the canonical localization factors on a pair of flat-term K-flat complexes. Any two normalized comparisons then agree at that pair. The resolving localization theorem for site derived tensor makes precomposition by the product of the resolving inclusions injective on natural transformations. Transport the equality to homotopy-model representatives with quotientCompQhIso and naturality, and apply that injectivity. Hence the comparisons agree on all derived objects and morphisms. Tuple the component data; braidedComparison equals the selected comparison by reflexivity.
